six_region_scope: cargo: largest actual triangle per signed dominant world-normal axis; UV bounding boxes must be distinct and disjoint. This verifies six representative directions, not all island overlap, text semantics, or complete surface-manifest coverage. Beveled-box keeps near-axis and projected-area thresholds.
method: GLB binary accessor positions + node transforms; singular values of world-to-UV-pixel Jacobian per triangle. Not metadata claims.

flat_windows.scope: Declared main face interiors only; atlas padding, gutters and neighbouring faces excluded. Narrow faces use min(8,width) x min(8,height) auxiliary windows, not an 8x8 claim. RGB variation only, not alpha; manifest coverage is not inferred from geometry.
